# Avatar

User or entity image with an initials fallback. The image needs alt text; the fallback is shown until it loads. ring adds the brand gradient border; AvatarGroup overlaps avatars with a background ring.

## Import

```tsx

// or the per-component entry point
import { Avatar } from "@cesuain/ui/avatar";
```

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `avatar.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library and runs axe-core on the rendered output (contrast is checked at token level). Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
